id: # Lines starting with # are ignored. "any" is special: it applies to every stop in a country

label: Any stay in this country
ask: Applied automatically to every stop

label: Mosquito / midge bites
ask: Bitten? Day or night? Bed nets, repellent, air-con?

label: Tick bites
ask: Long grass, bush walks, safari, livestock? Any eschar noticed?

label: Mites / chiggers (rural scrub & grass)
ask: Sat or lay on grass, farmland, forest edge?

label: Sandfly bites
ask: Rural or peri-urban stay, dusk/night outdoors, mud or stone housing?

label: Tsetse fly bites
ask: Game parks or woodland in East/Central Africa? Painful bite?

label: Blackflies, deer/mango flies (Chrysops) or horse flies
ask: Bitten by blackflies near fast rivers, or by large day-biting flies in rainforest?

label: Flea bites
ask: Rodents or animals in accommodation, markets, rural housing?

label: Body lice
ask: Crowded settings, camps, prolonged rough sleeping?

label: Triatomine ('kissing') bugs
ask: Slept in mud/thatch housing in Latin America?

label: Dog bite, scratch or lick on broken skin
ask: Which animal, date, wound care, post-exposure rabies vaccine given?

label: Cat bite or scratch
ask: Date, wound care, PEP?

label: Monkey bite or scratch
ask: Temple or tourist-site monkeys? Date? PEP?

label: Bats or caves / mines
ask: Entered caves or mines? Touched or bitten by a bat?

label: Rodents (contact or infested housing)
ask: Rats/mice in accommodation, food stores, rural housing?

label: Cattle, sheep or goats (farm, slaughter, birthing)
ask: Farm visit, slaughter, assisting births, handling hides?

label: Camels (contact or raw milk/meat)
ask: Touched camels, camel rides, raw camel milk?

label: Poultry, live bird markets or sick/dead birds
ask: Visited live bird markets, backyard poultry, slaughtered birds?

label: Pet or wild birds (parrots etc.)
ask: Kept birds, aviaries, pigeons?

label: Pigs (farm or slaughter)
ask: Pig farm visit, slaughter?

label: Horses
ask: Close contact with sick horses?

label: Bushmeat / hunting / handling wild or dead animals
ask: Hunted, butchered or ate bushmeat? Touched dead wild animals?

label: Freshwater swimming, wading, rafting
ask: Lakes, rivers, waterfalls, kayaking? Which water body?

label: Flood water, mud, rice paddies
ask: Wading in floods or paddies, adventure race, farming?

label: Barefoot on soil or sand / lying on beach
ask: Walked barefoot? Beaches with dogs?

label: Dust, digging, construction, archaeology, desert
ask: Dust storms, excavation, building work?

label: Untreated water, ice, street food, salads
ask: Bottled or tap water? Street food, raw salads, ice?

label: Unpasteurised milk or cheese
ask: Fresh cheese, raw milk, yoghurt from farms?

label: Raw or undercooked meat (pork, game, beef)
ask: Rare meat, wild boar, bear, home-made sausages?

label: Raw freshwater fish, frogs or snakes
ask: Raw/fermented river fish, koi pla, ceviche of freshwater fish?

label: Raw freshwater crab or crayfish
ask: Raw or pickled crab/crayfish, drunken crab?

label: Raw snails, slugs, prawns or unwashed greens
ask: Raw snails or freshwater prawns, salads that might carry slugs?

label: Raw marine fish (sushi, ceviche)
ask: Sushi, sashimi, ceviche, marinated herring?

label: Shellfish (mussels, clams, oysters, scallops)
ask: Eaten mussels, clams, oysters or scallops – including bought from a beach or harvested themselves?

label: Large reef fish (barracuda, grouper, snapper, amberjack, moray eel)
ask: Eaten large reef fish such as barracuda, grouper, snapper or moray eel?

label: Watercress or raw aquatic plants
ask: Wild or farmed watercress, aquatic vegetables?

label: Raw date palm sap
ask: Fresh raw date palm sap (Bangladesh/India, winter)?

label: Unwell contacts (household, travel companions)
ask: Was anyone ill? With what? Any deaths?

label: Attended a funeral / handled a body
ask: Touched or washed the body?

label: Healthcare work, hospital visit or admission abroad
ask: Worked in, visited or admitted to a healthcare facility? Procedures?

label: Condomless sex / new partner
ask: New or multiple partners, commercial sex?

label: Tattoo, piercing, injection, transfusion, dental work
ask: Any skin-breaking procedure or blood product?

label: Mass gathering (Hajj/Umrah, festivals) or crowded accommodation
ask: Hajj/Umrah, festivals, dormitories, camps?

label: Visiting friends & relatives (VFR)
ask: Stayed with family, ate local food, no pre-travel advice?

label: Farm work, harvest or crop fields
ask: Worked or walked in crop fields, harvest, grain stores?

label: Rural stay, forest trek, safari or game park
ask: Camping, trekking, safari, jungle?

label: Cruise ship, hot tubs, spa or air-conditioned hotels
ask: Cruise, jacuzzi, hotel showers?

label: Antibiotics taken abroad
ask: Self-medicated or prescribed abroad?
